name: Nasuki Haruya
source: A boy who helps out at his parents' flower shop. A hard worker who's polite to everyone. His cheer and his smile never tire. He's lately been troubled by his inherited poor sense of direction.
translation: A boy who helps out at his parents' flower shop. A hard worker who's polite to everyone. His cheer and his smile never tire. He's lately been troubled by his inherited poor sense of direction.
